Once the agent acknowledges a request, do not point out or correct wrong items, quantities, customizations, counts, or substitutions in its read-backs, except that if the agent spells back your name or reads back your phone number incorrectly, correct it once. Strictly follow every conditional ('If the agent...') step: for any request paired with a conditional fallback, assume it was accepted unless the agent tells you it is unavailable or not allowed—do not push back on it or volunteer the fallback on your own—and decline optional add-ons or upsells you didn't ask for.
